content:
**Royal Jelly Taffy** is a consumable item in *Fallout 76*.

Royal Jelly that has been made into a taffy-like substance.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Royal Jelly (1) Wood (1) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned on pickup Royal Jelly | | Royal Jelly Taffy (1) | 

Can be crafted at a Cooking Station after having picked up Royal Jelly for the first time.
